Job Summary
Locus Design Collaborative is a dynamic Architecture firm, focused on projects primarily in Fairfield (CT) and Westchester (NY) counties. We are a design-focused architectural firm seeking an experienced Senior Architect to join our team, with a focus on corporate interiors, workplace design, and commercial renovation projects.
This position is for a Project Architect/ Job Captain with approximately 8-15 years of experience. We will favor applicants whose personal qualities fit our friendly, collaborative office culture.
Responsibilities and Duties
Qualified candidates for this position are passionate about design and the details of each of their projects. Portfolio will clearly show strong technical skills, including both production and presentation.
This position suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced, multitasking environment and values productivity and efficiency balanced with quality.
Key Responsibilities
Lead corporate interiors and commercial renovation projects from concept through construction administration.
Develop space plans, design concepts, construction documents, and technical details.
Manage project schedules, deliverables, and coordination with clients, consultants, contractors, and vendors.
Coordinate architectural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other consultant drawings.
Apply knowledge of building codes, accessibility requirements, and construction practices to project design and documentation.
Review drawings for technical accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
Participate in site visits, construction meetings, and construction administration, including reviewing submittals and responding to RFIs.
Mentor junior staff and contribute to the overall quality and efficiency of our studio.
Qualified candidates should possess the following skills:
Professional degree in Architecture.
Minimum 8 years of professional architectural experience, preferably with a background in corporate interiors and commercial tenant improvements.
Strong proficiency in AutoCAD; Revit experience is a plus.
Thorough understanding of construction documentation, detailing, building codes, and accessibility requirements.
Experience coordinating with engineering consultants, contractors, and clients.
Excellent communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Architectural licensure required
What We're Looking For
We value individuals who are proactive, detail-oriented, and take pride in producing thoughtful, well-executed work. The right candidate will be equally comfortable developing a design solution, resolving a technical construction issue, and communicating directly with a client or contractor.
We are particularly interested in someone who enjoys the variety and responsibility that comes with working in a smaller architectural practice, where team members have a meaningful impact on projects and the firm's success.
